subject: design/maintenance-sweep-v1
statement: The maintenance sweep is **its own thin binary over one focused package** — never a verb on the document gate or the wake tick — running **one bounded, read-only pass**: load the single closed-parse **policy file** (waivers and bounds; reason-required entries), evaluate the **three detectors** as pure functions of the evaluated state (prd §4.1), and emit **one deterministic report** — a new closed machine-face schema on stdout, a human face on stderr, exit codes clean/findings/fault — then exit, nothing resident. Concrete schemas, paths, and the CLI grammar live in the paired non-frozen shape `shape:maintenance-sweep-v1`; this document carries only the decisions and invariants.
